treatments.name: Coronary Angioplasty (Heart Stent)
treatments.description: A minimally invasive procedure to widen clogged or narrowed coronary arteries to restore blood flow to the heart muscle using a medical stent.

treatments.name: Cataract Surgery (Laser Phacoemulsification)
treatments.description: Removal of the natural clouded lens of the eye and implantation of a premium artificial intraocular lens (IOL). Done as an outpatient day care procedure.

treatments.name: Total Knee Replacement
treatments.description: Surgical replacement of a severely diseased knee joint with high-grade metal/ceramic prosthetics to remove pain and restore natural movement.

treatments.name: Cesarean Section (C-Section Birth)
treatments.description: Surgical delivery of a baby through an incision made in the mother's abdomen and uterus, including general safety care for newborn.

treatments.name: Laparoscopic Gallbladder Removal (Cholecystectomy)
treatments.description: Removal of the gallbladder through several tiny incisions using a laparoscope. Advised for patients with painful, persistent gallstones.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
schemes.eligibility: Identified low-income families under SECC 2011 database, Ration card holders
schemes.description: National Health Protection Scheme that covers secondary and tertiary hospitalization care fully cashless across empanelled government and private clinics in India.
benefits: Surgical care coverage for 1393+ procedural setups
No limit on family size or age constraints

schemes.name: Bihar Mukhyamantri Chikitsa Sahayata
schemes.eligibility: Permanent residents of Bihar with annual family income below ₹2.5 Lakhs
documentsRequired: Medical Superintendent referral letter from PMCH/IGIMS
schemes.description: State-funded assistance scheme to help marginal families undergoing super-specialty surgeries (like open heart, kidney failure, cancer treatments).
benefits: Direct central payment release to the medical institute

reviews.comment: Extremely quick care in emergency card wing. My uncle got admitted for angioplasty. Star Health cashless was coordinated within 3 hours. Standard costs are slightly high, but critical doctor response is top class.
Great treatment for kidney stone issues. Cost of medicines and testing was extremely low because of Government support scheme. OPD lines are very long though; we stood for 2.5 hours.
Simply the best orthopedics treatment in Eastern India. Highly qualified AIIMS doctors and very clean campus. They took care of Ayushman card help-desk support beautifully.
Emergency traumatology department did a lifesaving fracture surgery at zero cost. Doctors are incredibly expert, but ward cleanliness needs big improvement and lines are huge.
